title: Overcast / pure white skies
summary: Iceland's default sky: a giant white softbox that blows out and drags the mood gray.
why: A flat bright sky reads mid-gray to the meter, so the camera overexposes it into a detail-free white sheet — and everything under it goes muddy. Bias down and the clouds keep their texture.

steps.text: Set the mode dial to A, front dial to f/8
Hold WB, spin rear dial to Cloudy

pitfalls: Sky will clip anyway if it fills the frame — compose with less sky, or embrace the white as negative space.
levelUp: Soft light is portrait light: overcast days are the days for faces, waterfalls, and saturated moss — save the vistas for drama.
